plain_statement: It is false that: Some constant c has: for every graph with no cycle shorter than 5 and at least one edge, every least top-form fan-in-exactly-two AND/OR circuit for its edge function has at most c times (gates + 1) unowned (U*) edges uv for which no gate has an OR-shadow of at least two vertices, all adjacent to u, and an operand of OR-shadow exactly {v}.
